chunks: Among them is Abul Husain Muhammad ibn Ja'far Asadi, may Allah have mercy on him.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ: Abu al-Husayn (a kunya, a patronymic nickname)
key_terms.الْأَسَدِيُّ: Al-Asadi (a nisba indicating lineage or tribe)
key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on him (a common honorific for deceased scholars)
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ: Muhammad ibn Ja'far (the specific name of the deputy)

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Ja'far Asadi among the four special deputies?
ai.summary: This passage identifies Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi as one of the four special deputies (al-nuwwab al-arba'ah) who served as the primary intermediaries between the Twelfth Imam and the general community during the Minor Ghaiba. His inclusion highlights the structured hierarchy of authority that maintained religious continuity and guided the Shia community in the absence of the Imam's physical presence.
